data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after one of your **TZEENTCH MUTANT** units is **selected to fight**.

**Target:** That **TZEENTCH MUTANT** unit.

**Effect:** For each model in the unit, these apply for the rest of the phase: its [pile-in moves](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move) and [consolidation moves](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) can go up to 6" rather than up to 3"; it is **eligible to fight** if it is up to 3" from an enemy model; and it can target an enemy unit that is up to 3" from it and in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of its unit.
